en.headline: Police set phased road closures in Central for Halloween
en.dek: Roads around Lan Kwai Fong will close in stages from 2pm on Friday through early Saturday and Sunday to manage crowds.
body: Police announced special traffic arrangements for the Halloween period in Central, with road closures from October 30 to November 1.

From 2pm on Friday, D’Aguilar Street between Wyndham Street and Wellington Street, Lan Kwai Fong, Wing Wah Lane, Wo On Lane, Wellington Street between Wyndham Street and D’Aguilar Street, and On Lan Street will be closed to all vehicles until 5am the next day. Further closures may follow from 7pm and 8pm depending on crowd levels, covering parts of Queen’s Road Central, Ice House Street, Wyndham Street and other nearby streets.

Motorcycle parking spaces on Stanley Street near D’Aguilar Street, On Lan Street and part of Wyndham Street will be suspended from 1pm. Illegally parked vehicles may be towed without warning. Police said arrangements would be adjusted according to conditions and advised the public to follow officers’ instructions on site.

zh.headline: 警方就萬聖節在中區分階段封路
zh.dek: 蘭桂坊一帶道路將由周五下午二時起分階段封閉至周六及周日清晨，以配合人群管理。
body: 警方宣布，為配合萬聖節慶祝活動，中區將於十月三十日至十一月一日期間實施特別交通安排。
周五下午二時起至翌日清晨五時，介乎雲咸街及威靈頓街的德己立街、蘭桂坊、榮華里、和安里、介乎雲咸街及德己立街的威靈頓街，以及安蘭街將禁止所有車輛駛入。視乎人流，晚上七時及八時或會進一步封閉皇后大道中、雪廠街、雲咸街等路段。
士丹利街近德己立街、安蘭街及雲咸街部分電單車泊位將由下午一時起暫停使用。違例停泊車輛或會被拖走而不作事先警告。警方表示會因應現場情況調整安排，並呼籲市民遵從在場警員指示。
